access_scope: Historical bibliography from the original experiment. Executable protocol: OFAT_SPEC.json, exclusion amendment and src/common.py resolver.

references.title: The adaptive Wynn-algorithm in generalized linear models with univariate response
references.implementation_relation: Adaptive Wynn connection; batched ridge implementation is specified by this protocol.

references.title: Near-Optimal Design of Experiments via Regret Minimization
references.implementation_relation: Motivation for relaxation and rounding; continuous support-generation implementation is not the paper finite-subset algorithm.

references.title: Improved Algorithms for Linear Stochastic Bandits
references.implementation_relation: Ellipsoidal confidence and UCB background; no transfer of regret theorem claimed.

references.title: Parametric Bandits: The Generalized Linear Case
references.implementation_relation: GLM optimistic control background; implemented latent-predictor ellipsoid is not original GLM-UCB.

references.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Thompson Sampling
references.implementation_relation: TS background; implemented Gaussian/Laplace perturbations with active constraints are not a truncated posterior.
